Emily / team —

Technical caveats from SRE: we can support the hosted uplift and tagging approach, but please note:

- Fairness policy interaction: priority tags increase scheduling weight but do not preempt Dedicated reservations. If platform-wide global congestion occurs (rare), we will move to a fairness algorithm that enforces proportional throttling to preserve overall availability.
- KV cache: for sustained high QPS with repeated prefixes, enabling prefix caching will reduce tail latency substantially — we can provision cache hints, but cache warm-up time is ~10–20 minutes at scale.
- Observation and rollback: we’ll monitor latency/queue sizes in real time and have a rollback plan that (a) throttles non-critical routes, (b) increases batch sizes to improve throughput, and (c) if necessary, fails over to a lower-cost variant model.

If Starlens needs hard latency guarantees under global congestion, Dedicated is the only path to deterministic tail latency. For the hosted uplift, proposed SLOs in Laura’s note are reasonable.

Credit calculation (proposed language):
- If fairness throttling materially reduces served requests below the agreed burst profile for >15 continuous minutes, Redwood will issue a credit equal to: (Average billed tokens during the impacted minutes) * 1.25 * (minutes impacted / total scheduled minutes).
- Example: If your profile expected 10,000 billed tokens per minute and during an impacted 30-minute window you averaged 7,000 billed tokens/min, credit = (10,000 - 7,000) * 1.25 * (30 / 4320) for a 3-day window (4320 minutes).

Headers: X-Redwood-Priority is safe and will be preserved. Avoid relying on X-Forwarded-For values for priority; we recommend the priority header be set from your app layer before hitting CDN. If you must use CDN, confirm that it passes custom headers through (we can provide an RFC-style list).

I’ll update the PDF with the credit formula and the precise addendum wording and send over a DocuSign link for the narrow addendum only. Once you confirm, we’ll activate the uplift in your org and schedule a 30-minute runbook call 24 hours before the start.
